**How to edit this file**

- Change only the text underneath a `###` heading. That text is what the game
  says.
- Leave the `##` headings, the `<!-- key: ... -->` comments and the `###`
  field names alone. They are how the text finds its way home.
- Keep any `%s` and `%d` exactly as they are. The game fills them in with a
  name or a level, and a line that loses one will break.
- Blank lines inside a passage are kept. Leading and trailing ones are not.
- Speaker names are part of the line ("Elder: Good morning."). The dialogue
  box splits them off itself, so keep the `Name: ` prefix.

## A DEAD CHAMPION — Area Three

<!-- key: scene:area_three.tscn:Actors/LastChampion -->

<sub>game/areas/area_three.tscn · `Actors/LastChampion`</sub>

### display_name

A DEAD CHAMPION

### dialogue_line

A dead champion of the Order sits with her back to a dead tree, seal-iron still on her chest, and does not get up.

You made it further than I did, she says, without much interest. He is up the road, past the pillars, on the barrow.

Mind the two in the glades. You will think you know them. You met the real ones on your way down and you left them both standing. Go on. I will keep the stair.

## SkeletonLord — Area Three

<!-- key: scene:area_three.tscn:Actors/SkeletonLord -->

<sub>game/areas/area_three.tscn · `Actors/SkeletonLord`</sub>

### challenge_line

<!-- speaker: The Skeleton Lord -->

Do you know what you are interrupting? I am waiting. I have been waiting on this seat since the hour I reached past the door of the world and took my son back through it.

The Skeleton Lord: He is still coming. He has been coming for four hundred years. Put your oath down and wait with me, or put it to use. It makes very little difference which.

### sealed_line

A crowned thing sits on the barrow at the end of the wood, wrapped in green fire, and does not look up. Whatever is left of the Kingsworn's faith is the only reason it has not already noticed you.

### victory_line

The green fire goes out, and the crown slides off his skull.

The Skeleton Lord: Not gone... Come back in a hundred years and I will still be waiting on him...

As the seat empties, bells begin to ring somewhere far above. And for once, nobody is pulling the rope. The tyrant has been slain!
